Name: CP - Fancy Iron Gate
Author: hadiwrites42
Description:
If you've ever CP patched a fence, you'll notice that you have to place your neat custom gates on TOP of an existing fence for it to appear; the gate reverts to vanilla if you place it in an empty spot, which results in that odd stick gate every chicken would walk under within seconds of building it.

That's why I wanted a general gate [b][color=#e06666][size=4]replacer[/size][/color][/b], to get rid of the vanilla gate that haunts my chicken-less nightmares. It's friendly to vanilla fences AND modded fences.

(Also, it's loosely based on an old naver mod I had, but I resprited from scratch; any similarities are due to the basic design, there's only so much you can do with pixel lines for this type of fence).

The gate only opens in one direction when it's a single gate (amazing I know) and gains double doors as a double gate (gaSP); technically the color is a dark green, but it's hard to see in my recolored playthrough.
